label: Live captions softkey
description: Adds a softkey to the call screen that opens live captions for the call (Convergent dashboard agent) in the phone's XML browser.

variables.label: Captions URL
variables.help: Opened by the phone itself. {ext} = the phone's extension, {pbx} = the PBX address for the phone's provisioning network (the tunnel address for VPN phones). Add ?k=<token> if the agent requires one.
